body:
>  Given this enum seems to only exist for the sake of compatibility with MikkTSpace, and isn't actually used anywhere in the codebase, should it be removed as well?

This is part of meshoptimizer API, so I left it for now in case we need it anywhere else. I could remove it but we do something similar for simplification where some flags exposed by the library aren't used yet but might be useful in the future.

> There's also a few lingering references to MikkTSpace across a handful of shader implementations, which might no longer be relevant

These presumably? They are still accurate to some extent in the sense that the new implemenation has the same properties; it's most accurate to call it the alternative implementation of MikkTSpace algorithm. But I could remove these if that helps; the interpolation logic I'm not sure is "per MikkTSpace" anyhow, as the vertex *inputs* were unit-length in the vertex before & after this change, but the normalization is necessary due to the transformation.

> scene/resources/material.cpp:           // Binormal is negative due to mikktspace. Flipping it "unflips" it.
> servers/rendering/renderer_rd/shaders/forward_clustered/scene_forward_clustered.glsl:   // See: http://www.mikktspace.com/
> servers/rendering/renderer_rd/shaders/forward_clustered/scene_forward_clustered.glsl:   // See: http://www.mikktspace.com/
> servers/rendering/renderer_rd/shaders/forward_mobile/scene_forward_mobile.glsl: // See: http://www.mikktspace.com/
> servers/rendering/renderer_rd/shaders/forward_mobile/scene_forward_mobile.glsl: // See: http://www.mikktspace.com/

Upon further review, the shader comments basically refer to the "Pixel Shader Transformation" section on http://www.mikktspace.com/. The vertex shader normalization is due to the scaling implied by the transformation; but that comment is not really very MikkTSpace specific. The pixel shader normalization is the option recommended by MikkTSpace algorithm and that doesn't change hence the comment is still accurate. So I feel like the fragment shader comment should be left in tact; we could remove the vertex shader comment as it's a little redundant, or leave it as is.

As an aside: the vertex transformation of tangent/bitangent is incorrect in `scene*.glsl` :) I'll file a separate issue for this. Normal matrix must only be used for normal transformation, tangent plane vectors have to be transformed using the original model transform.
